title: glechoma sewerzowii
intro: Glechoma sewerzowii, commonly known as Russian sage, is a perennial plant species belonging to the mint family. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma sewerzowii include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
